ratifyDecisions.ratify1_siblings_vs_sections: KEEP navigation/dock-layers + navigation/rail as SIBLING routes (the consolidation target is the SCATTER — token-ladder out of foundations/, dock-with-slider out of compositions/ — not a single-page merge). The amend (A.1) reverses this toward a first-class `dock` CATEGORY, but W18 owns that category creation + EXPECTED_TREE re-baseline; W06 lands first within the existing tree (single-writer split — W06 writes SFC bodies, W18 writes manifest dock rows).
ratifyDecisions.ratify2_narrow_mechanism: DISCRIMINATED PROP UNION (the compile-time narrow, one-path). The honest-rail surface is a union of DockVariantProps (the horizontal dock branch, carries collapseDelay/startCollapsed/layout) | DockRailProps (rail/instrument-strip, no collapse surface). REQUIRED pure defineProps<DockProps>() — withDefaults over a union props type degrades the runtime inference to Record<string,any> and ERASES the narrow; defaults are now applied via ?? at each read site.
ratifyDecisions.ratify3_instrument_rail_disambig: SIGNPOST now (the manifest rail description + the rail.vue naming section disambiguate Dock Rail vs Instrument Rail vs the layer-switcher rail — the three-way noun collision, amend A.3); the Instrument-Rail DISSOLUTION is routed to W28/W29 (not pre-emptively done here).
ratifyDecisions.ratify4_carve_shape: THIN dock.css CORE + @import-ed partials. The core keeps the @property --dock-morph-t registration + the SHARED cross-control four-state comma-groups (which legitimately live at the import root — they reference EVERY control family) + the @imports. This preserves the existing proof:dock-css-split coherence anchor (which reads dock.css for the shared :where()/:focus-visible groups) AND the index.css @import "./dock.css" chain, while every partial + the core clear < 500. (A full dissolve would break that existing AU.W8b.3 gate — the constraint RATIFY-#4 did not weigh.)

usf2_optical_size.rootCause: DarkModeToggle renders its OWN internal SVG h-full w-full (it bypasses the --dock-icon-glyph-sized > svg slot); in-dock, --dark-mode-toggle-padding fell to var(--dock-icon-padding, 0) but --dock-icon-padding is NEVER DEFINED → 0 padding → the SVG filled the box (~2.5x the nav glyphs).
usf2_optical_size.fix: route the in-dock toggle glyph through --dock-control-glyph-size (default = --dock-icon-glyph, the --dock-scale-keyed glyph the nav icons paint), scoped to the in-dock path ONLY (h-full w-full stays correct standalone). One token the dock-control family reads — optically uniform when docked.
